item.title: Yuusha no Tamago Maou no Shikaku
item.description:
ゲーム情報

  • ブランド: Nishino
  • 発売日: 2023-05-03
  • スコア: なし (1 人評価)
  • 日本語名: 勇者のたまごと魔王の刺客
  • 英語名: Yuusha no Tamago Maou no Shikaku

あらすじ

This is a world where humans and demons have been fighting for ages to protect their respective rights and to seize them.

One day, a boy and his father save some girls from a monster and invite them into their home. However, the girls are actually assassins sent by the Demon King to trap the boy, who was born into this world as a hero .
